Introduction
AI agents are becoming one of the most talked-about ideas in technology. You may hear people say that agents can write code, search the web, fix bugs, summarize documents, create plans, or even complete tasks from start to finish. At first, this can sound mysterious. entry.title: Why Does Your Local Model Crash at 32k Tokens?
entry.summary: In this video: 0:00 The Crash Nobody Can Explain You checked the model size against your VRAM, confirmed it fit, and watched it run fine. So why did it crash forty minutes into a long conversation? The weights never grew. Something else did. Most guides budget one number: the model's weight size. They ignore a second, independent one. You ask it a quick question, it answers in a second, and everything looks fine. So you keep going.
